description: Trigger-quality cases for the model-invoked skills. should_trigger cases must route to their own skill; should_not_trigger cases must stay below threshold everywhere; near_neighbor cases must not steal routes from their confusable sibling. Every case derives from a real routing situation or a documented failure (see failures/).

should_trigger.text: Audit this module from architecture, flow, and scenario dimensions together.
Route this UI audit request through the product design modes with a screenshot.
Design and build a complete responsive web dashboard from these requirements.
Implement the approved plan in dependency order, staying inside the whitelist.
Turn this accepted scope into an implementation plan with a file list.
Fix the Critical findings from the code review report and verify with tests.
Build a focused mental model of the tech stack and conventions here.
Which architecture and security principles apply to this design decision?
Write the post-implementation retrospective with divergences from the plan.
Probe the payment service for security vulnerabilities and concurrency risks.
Extract the design tokens and atomic CSS from this rendered page.
Analyze the architecture, dependency graph, and design patterns of this repository.
Turn these user stories into a formal PRD with an MVP scope.
Give me an evidence-backed verdict: DONE, DONE-WITH-ACCEPTED-RISKS, or BLOCKED.
Apply the surgical fix for the root cause and add a regression test.
Review my uncommitted changes against our coding standards before I open a PR.
Before we run the database drop, put the double confirmation checkpoint in front of it.

should_not_trigger.text: Harden this Linux host firewall and install port-scan detection.
Explain what a closure is in JavaScript, just a quick answer.
Push the verified branch to the remote repository now.
Summarize this article in three bullet points.
Write a haiku about autumn leaves for my blog.
Submit a pull request for the current branch.
Plan my birthday party next weekend with a guest list.
Update the Docker Compose images with health checks and rollback.

near_neighbor.text: Route the product design request: ideas, screenshots, UI audits, prototypes.
Map the dependency graph, coupling, and patterns across the whole codebase.
Check production failure surfaces and data integrity before release hardening.
Apply the minimal patch and its regression test for the diagnosed bug.
Freeze executable requirements, contracts, and the checklist into a spec.
Produce the phased implementation plan with steps and file list.
Align requirements with blocker questions and a playback brief first.
Build the complete production web page with responsive layout from requirements.
Review this diff for standards violations and spec compliance.
